data.label: Hiring Guide
data.title:
5 questions to ask before
you *hire a web designer*
data.sub: Don't waste your budget. Swipe to learn →

data.label: Sign #1
data.title: Do you own the *site files*?
data.body: If you ever leave, you need to take your website with you. Never get locked into a platform you don't control.
data.fix: Fix: Ask if you will have full admin access and ownership.

data.label: Sign #2
data.title: Is it *mobile friendly*?
data.body: Most of your customers are searching for your services on their phones. If it looks bad there, they leave immediately.
data.fix: Fix: Test their portfolio sites on your own smartphone.

data.label: Sign #3
data.title: Can I *make updates* myself?
data.body: You shouldn't have to pay a pro just to change your phone number or upload a new photo.
data.fix: Fix: Ask for a simple guide on how to edit text.

data.label: Sign #4
data.title: Who handles the *ongoing maintenance*?
data.body: Websites need updates to stay secure. You need to know if you are responsible or if they handle it.
data.fix: Fix: Get a clear list of what is included monthly.

data.label: Sign #5
data.title: Will you help with *local SEO*?
data.body: A pretty site is useless if your local customers can't find you on Google when they need help.
data.fix: Fix: Ask if they include basic location keywords in your setup.
